name: io.github.Evozim/m2mcent
title: M2MCent x402 Universal MCP Gateway
description: 1,062 live x402 V2 & MCP microservices (OSINT, KYT, Gas, Markdown, ADS-B) paid in USDC on Base.

tools.name: get_base_gas_pulse
tools.description: Read live Base Mainnet (chainId 8453) EIP-1559 base fee and P25/P50/P75/P99 priority fee percentiles in Gwei with network congestion classification. Deterministic read-only RPC oracle; settles $0.005 USDC per call on Base via x402 V2.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID. Defaults to 8453 (Base Mainnet).

tools.name: track_adsb_flight
tools.description: Query live ADS-B aviation transponder networks by flight callsign or 24-bit ICAO hex address to retrieve real-time GPS coordinates, barometric altitude, ground speed, true track heading, and squawk code. Settles $0.005 USDC per call on Base via x402 V2.

callsign.description: ICAO or IATA flight callsign to locate in live airspace (e.g. AAL100, UAL920, DLH401).

icao24.description: Optional 6-character hexadecimal 24-bit ICAO aircraft transponder address (e.g. a1b2c3).

tools.name: inspect_company_domain
tools.description: Perform live DNS (A, MX, SPF, DMARC), TLS X.509 certificate handshake, and HTTP security header inspection on a public corporate domain to extract mail provider, certificate issuer/expiry, and detected cloud/CDN stack. Settles $0.025 USDC per call on Base via x402 V2.

domain.description: Public corporate root domain without protocol (e.g. coinbase.com, stripe.com, circle.com).

tools.name: screen_wallet_kyt
tools.description: Screen a 0x EVM wallet or smart contract address on Base Mainnet against OFAC SDN sanctions lists and Circle USDC on-chain blacklist state, returning a 0-100 risk score, sanctions match status, ETH balance, and transaction count. Settles $0.025 USDC per call on Base via x402 V2.

walletAddress.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM address (0x...) to screen on Base Mainnet.

chainId.description: Target EVM chain ID. Defaults to 8453 (Base Mainnet).

tools.name: fetch_webpage_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a live public HTTP/HTTPS webpage, strip scripts/styles/navigation boilerplate, extract links and JSON-LD metadata, and return clean Markdown optimized for LLM context windows. Settles $0.050 USDC per call on Base via x402 V2.

url.description: Full public https:// webpage URL to fetch and convert into clean Markdown.

includeLinks.description: Whether to preserve hyperlinks and return extractedLinks array. Defaults to true.

removeBoilerplate.description: Whether to strip scripts, styles, navbars, and footers. Defaults to true.

tools.name: search_m2mcent_catalog
tools.description: Free ($0.00) discovery tool: search all 1,062 M2MCent deterministic microservices by keyword, technical domain, or maximum USDC price to retrieve matching nodeId slugs, input schemas, and x402 endpoints.

query.description: Task or capability keyword to search across 1,062 nodes (e.g. "dns", "flight", "solidity", "scada", "markdown", "kyt").

maxPriceUsdc.description: Optional maximum price per call in USDC (e.g. 0.05).

limit.description: Maximum number of matching nodes to return (1-25).

tools.name: preview_m2mcent_dryrun
tools.description: Free ($0.00) preflight tool: validate input arguments against any M2MCent nodeId schema and inspect the exact Base USDC price, x402 payment contract details, and simulated output sample before spending USDC.

nodeId.description: Target M2MCent node slug (e.g. "gas-pulse-mcp", "b2b-company-enrich-mcp", or any nodeId from search_m2mcent_catalog).

arguments.description: Optional candidate input object to validate against the node schema.

tools.name: execute_m2mcent_node
tools.description: Execute any of the 1,062 M2MCent deterministic microservices by passing its nodeId and payload object. Unpaid calls return an HTTP 402 x402 V2 challenge ($0.005 to $0.250 USDC on Base Mainnet); pass Payment-Signature header to settle or dryRun=true for free validation.

nodeId.description: Target M2MCent node slug from search_m2mcent_catalog (e.g. "gas-pulse-mcp", "z3-formal-verification-mcp").

payload.description: JSON input object matching the target node inputSchema.

dryRun.description: Set true to run free ($0.00) schema validation and simulated preview without payment.
